subject: Marketplace crediting cutover + reseller billing lag discussion
body:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@apexcloud.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@apexcloud.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace crediting cutover + reseller billing lag discussion

Maya / ProcureOps team —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Two follow-ups from our side so we can close the private offer cleanly:

1) Cutover timing: ApexCloud wants the marketplace crediting to start on the first day of the contract month (June 1).
2) Billing lag / reseller brokerage invoicing: Apex flagged that their reseller (BrightEdge) invoices monthly and typically processes rebates/commissions on a 30–60 day lag. They need clarity on how the Redwood credit will flow through the marketplace and then to the reseller so accounting can reconcile.

Attached is the private offer (redwood_private_offer_4871.pdf) and a simple cutover schedule we discussed. Can you confirm the flow below? If agreed, we'll route to Billing for any invoice-path constraints.

Proposed flow (high level):
- Redwood applies marketplace credit to ApexCloud's monthly invoice at the marketplace level on billing close.
- Marketplace posts a net invoice to ApexCloud; BrightEdge (reseller) then issues an internal broker invoice to ApexCloud at their standard cadence.
- Because BrightEdge's commissions are settled monthly with a 30–60 day processing lag, ApexCloud expects cash timing differences; they want Redwood to confirm whether early credits will be issued as an upfront offset or as a retrospective invoice adjustment.

If Redwood needs to issue a direct manual credit to BrightEdge to avoid a lagged reconciliation, please let us know operationally what format you need (PO, broker invoice, or a credit memo).

Connor
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---

From: Maya Patel <maya@apexcloud.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@apexcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace crediting cutover + reseller billing lag discussion

Connor —

Thanks — that matches our expectations. Quick clarifications from procurement:

- Apex needs the marketplace credit applied to the invoice line item called "PrivateOffer Adjustment" so our AR system maps it automatically.
- BrightEdge will not accept a manual credit memo from Redwood to them unless it references Apex's PO number and the BrightEdge broker code.
- If Redwood can produce a broker invoice stub (CSV) that BrightEdge can consume, that will significantly reduce manual reconciliation.

I can loop in BrightEdge's AP contact if you want them to confirm the CSV format.

Maya
Senior Procurement Manager
ApexCloud

---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace crediting cutover + reseller billing lag discussion

Irene / Vanessa / Ben —

Forwarding Apex's note. Key asks:
- Apex wants the credit applied to a specific invoice line item ("PrivateOffer Adjustment") so their AR system picks it up.
- BrightEdge will only accept a credit memo referencing Apex PO + broker code OR a CSV broker-invoice stub.

Operational questions for Billing/Finance:
1) Can Redwood write credits that include an external PO reference and broker code?
2) Do we have a standard CSV schema we can provide to resellers (or to Apex to pass onward)?
3) If BrightEdge posts commissions on a 30–60 day lag, are we comfortable with a retrospective reconciliation (i.e., Redwood issues a credit in month N that BrightEdge pays/records in N+1 / N+2), or do we need to pre-fund/adjust to keep Apex AR balanced?

Ben — tagging you on the lag question and whether Ops can support a broker CSV export.

Thanks,
Connor

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace crediting cutover + reseller billing lag discussion

Team —

Thanks for the context. A few operational notes from Product Pricing and Marketplace Ops:

- We can tag Redwood marketplace credits with a custom memo field. We currently support free-form fields that map to marketplace line items, but we need the exact label Apex is using ("PrivateOffer Adjustment"). Please confirm the exact string (case-sensitive) and whether they include a trailing PO prefix.
- We do not currently generate a reseller CSV schema as a first-class output, but Engineering can produce a one-off CSV export that includes: reseller_code, apex_po, month, credit_amount, invoice_reference. That would be a manual ops job for onboarding this private offer.
- On the lag question: Finance prefers retrospective reconciliation (issue credit on Redwood side when usage closes). Pre-funding credits creates revenue recognition complexity and cash-out risk. If Apex needs a shorter timing window, we can offer a shortened reconciliation SLA (issue credit within 15 days of month close) for this deal, conditional on a small upfront Escrow (1% of committed value) to cover timing mismatch.

Action items:
- Connor: get Apex to confirm exact invoice line label and whether BrightEdge needs PO prefix.
- Ben: confirm whether Billing can produce a one-off CSV and whether we can create a credit memo that includes external PO reference / broker code in the memo field.
- Laura: if Apex accepts the 15-day accelerated reconciliation option, we need a short MSA addendum (1 paragraph) and an Escrow invoice template.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: marketplace-crediting-cutover-plan.xlsx

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace crediting cutover + reseller billing lag discussion

Quick operational confirmation from Billing/Revenue:

- We can include an external PO number and reseller_code in the credit memo memo field. The marketplace ingestion will surface that on the line so Apex's AR should be able to map automatically if they give us the exact string pattern.
- We can produce a one-off CSV with the columns Vanessa listed. Ops will need a signed request and a runbook (we will keep it manual; not productized). Expect a 5–7 business day lead time for the first export.
- Regarding timing: we will not pre-fund credits. We can commit to the 15-day accelerated reconciliation for this private offer provided Apex signs the Escrow addendum and we receive the initial Escrow invoice payment before the first billing close.

I'll draft the runbook template and the Escrow invoice language and drop them in the Drive link (DocuSign link to follow).

Ben Carter
Director, Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: invoice_path_diagram.png, redwood_private_offer_4871.pdf
